parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall shelves stocked with black crates and white boxes. A person in a yellow safety vest walks toward the camera on a concrete floor marked with blue lines. Orange forklifts are parked in aisles. Red safety blocks and overhead lighting are visible. The perspective is low, emphasizing movement through the industrial space.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Wearing a bright yellow safety vest over a dark jacket, blue jeans, and black work boots. Walking forward with hands in pockets. Partially blurred due to motion. Positioned centrally in the foreground, obscuring lower shelves behind them.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall metal racks filled with stacked black plastic crates and white cardboard boxes. Located along both sides of the aisle. Some shelves have red signs. Extends into the background, creating depth.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Two orange forklifts parked side-by-side in the background aisle. One has a visible operator in red shirt. Both have black tires and control panels. Positioned between shelves, partially obscured by the person walking.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete surface with blue painted lines marking pathways. Shows slight wear and dust. Occupied by the person’s feet and surrounded by pallets and equipment. Reflects overhead lights.

objects.label: red safety block
objects.observation: Large rectangular red block with textured surface. Placed on the right side of the aisle near a pillar. Appears freestanding. Serves as a visual marker or barrier.
